title.en: Space Crops and Advanced Tech Wrap Up Week Following Spacewalk
title.vi: Cay trong vu tru va cong nghe tien tien ket thuc tuan le sau chuyen di bo ngoai khong gian

hook.en: Space crops research wrapped up the week following the completion of the first of two power upgrade spacewalks at the International Space Station. The Expedition 75 crew members rounded out their research schedule with virtual reality and super intelligence studies.
hook.vi: Nghien cuu cay trong khong gian da khe lai tuan le sau khi hoan thanh dot di bo ngoai khong gian dau tien trong hai dot nang cap nang luong tai Tram Vu tru Quoc te. Cac thanh vien phi hanh doan Expedition 75 da hoan tat lich trinh nghien cuu cua ho voi cac nghien cuu ve thuc te ao va sieu tri tue.

sections.body_en: The orbital outpost has a new roll-out solar array that is generating power after flight engineers Anil Menon of NASA and Joshua Kutryk of CSA (Canadian Space Agency) installed it during a spacewalk on Thursday. Menon and Kutryk spent [y:seven hours and 11 minutes] in the vacuum of space attaching the roll-out solar array to the port side truss structure then releasing its tension bolts allowing the solar array to unfurl, or roll out, on its own during a ten-minute process.
sections.body_vi: Tien don tren quy dao nay co mot mang pin mat troi cuon moi dang tao ra nang luong sau khi cac ky su chuyen bay Anil Menon cua NASA va Joshua Kutryk cua CSA lap dat no trong mot chuyen di bo ngoai khong gian vao thu Nam. Menon va Kutryk da danh [y:seven hours and 11 minutes] trong chan khong cua vu tru de gan mang pin mat troi cuon vao cau truc gian ben trai, sau do giai phong cac bu-long cang de mang pin mat troi tu dong bung ra trong qua trinh muoi phut.

sections.body_en: The pair will install one more roll-out solar array on Thursday, Nov. 5, to complete the yearslong process that began in June 2021 to augment the space station’s power generation system. Menon and Kutryk will install the eighth and final roll-out solar array on the starboard side of the truss structure increasing the station’s power generating capacity from 160 kilowatts to [y:about 215 kilowatts].
sections.body_vi: Cap doi nay se lap dat them mot mang pin mat troi cuon vao thu Nam, ngay 5 thang 11, de hoan thanh qua trinh keo dai nhieu nam bat dau tu thang 6 nam 2021 nham tang cuong he thong tao nang luong cua tram vu tru. Menon va Kutryk se lap dat mang pin mat troi cuon thu tam va la cuoi cung o phia ngoai khoi cua cau truc gian, lam tang [y:about 215 kilowatts] cong suat tao ra cua tram.

sections.body_en: Menon and Kutryk had a light duty day on Friday with ongoing research planned for their short schedule. Menon worked on a [p:space botany investigation] in the Kibo laboratory module exploring how microgravity affects cell division on green algae and cultured tobacco cells. Results may support the production of food crops on the Moon and Mars. Kutryk pedaled on the European Enhanced Exploration Exercise Device’s (E4D) exercise cycle in the Columbus laboratory module. The compact all-in-one E4D is being tested for its ability to keep crews fit during a long-term spaceflight.
sections.body_vi: Menon va Kutryk da co mot ngay lam viec nhe nhang vao thu Sau voi cac nghien cuu dang dien ra cho lich trinh ngan cua ho. Menon da thuc hien mot [p:space botany investigation] trong mo-dun phong th nghiem Kibo, kham pha vi trong luc anh huong the nao den su phan chia te bao tren tao xanh va te bao thuoc la nuoi cay. Ket quả co the ho tro viec san xuat cay thuc pham tren Mat Trăng va Sao Hoa. Kutryk da dap tren xe dap tap the duc cua Thiet bi Tap the duc Khang nguyen Nang cao Chau Au (E4D) trong mo-dun phong thi nghiem Columbus.

sections.body_en:
NASA flight engineer Luke Delaney also studied space-based crops focusing on how to [p:prevent plant diseases] in microgravity. Delaney inoculated thale cress plant samples after they were exposed to a fungal pathogen then stowed the samples inside an artificial gravity-generating incubator. Results may improve crop disease resistance both on Earth and in space.

NASA flight engineer Jessica Watkins spent her shift servicing a variety of research hardware. She first removed and photographed components inside a device that powers experiments launched aboard spacecraft. Next, Watkins swapped moisture absorbers inside a set of portable science freezers that can be launched to the station and returned back to Earth housing frozen research samples for analysis.
sections.body_vi: Ky su chuyen bay cua NASA Luke Delaney cung nghien cuu cac loai cay trong khong gian tap trung vao cach [p:prevent plant diseases] trong vi trong luc. Delaney da tiem chung cac mau cay cai xo xo sau khi chung tiep xac voi mot loai nam gay benh, sau do cat giu cac mau ben trong mot thiet bi u tao trong luc nhan tao. Ket qua co the cai thien kha nang chong benh cay trong ca tren Trai Dat va trong khong gian.

sections.body_en:
Station commander Pyotr Dubrov of Roscosmos worked on a physics experiment swapping hardware inside a temperature-controlled chamber to explore manufacturing high-purity semiconductor crystals in microgravity. Flight engineer Sergey Teteryatnikov wore a [g:virtual reality headset] and responded to computerized visual stimuli to testing how his sense of balance and orientation is adapting to microgravity. Flight engineer Anna Kikina studied how super intelligence tools may increase operational and communications efficiency aboard a spacecraft.

*Learn more about station activities by following the* *space station blog**,* *@space_station* *on X, as well as the* *ISS Facebook* *and* *ISS Instagram* *accounts.*

sections.body_vi: Chi huy tram Pyotr Dubrov thuoc Roscosmos da lam viec trong mot thi nghiem vat ly bang cach hoan doi phan cung ben trong buong kiem tra nhiet do de kham pha viec san xuat cac Tinh the ban dan do tinh khiet cao trong vi trong luc. Ky su chuyen bay Sergey Teteryatnikov da deo mot [g:virtual reality headset] va phap ung voi cac kich thich thi giac may tinh de kiem tra cam giac can bang va dinh huong cua anh ay thich nghi the nao voi vi trong luc.

keyPoint.en: Like upgrading power grids on Earth to fuel a growing city, space stations continuously expand their energy and crop systems to push further into the cosmos. How can you optimize your own daily energy usage and personal growth this week?
keyPoint.vi: Giong nhu viec nang cap luoi dien tren Trai Dat de cung cap nang luong cho mot thanh pho dang phat trien, cac tram vu tru khong ngung mo rong he thong nang luong va cay trong de tien xa hon vao vu tru. [p:Ban co the toi uu hoa viec su dung nang luong hang ngay va su phat trien cua ban the nao trong tuan nay?]

en: Check your home power setup for any simple upgrades you can make to improve energy efficiency today.
Plant a small seed in a small pot and observe its growth over the next few days to connect with botany.
Do a ten-minute indoor cycling or stretching session to keep your body fit like astronauts do.
vi: Kiem tra lai he thong dien trong nha de thuc hien cac nang cap don gian giup tiet tiet kiem nang luong hom nay.
Trong mot hat mien dat vao chau nho va quan sat su phat trien cua no trong vai ngay toi de ket noi voi nganh thuc vat hoc.
Thuc hien mot bai tap dap xe trong nha hoac gian co trong muoi phut de giu dang nhu cac phi hanh gia.
